Detailed Definition: Rank firms by their annual revenue growth each year over the past 5 years. MeanRankRevGrowth is the weighted average of ranks over the past 5 years, that is, MeanRankRevGrowth = (5*Rank$_{t-1}$ + 4*Rank$_{t-2}$ + 3*Rank$_{t-3}$ + 2*Rank$_{t-4}$ + 1*Rank$_{t-5}$)/15. Exclude NASDAQ stocks.
